Maumee Bay to Reno Beach OH-Reno Beach to The Islands OH-
236 AM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 7 AM EST THIS MORNING
THROUGH THIS EVENING...

.TODAY...Southwest winds 15 to 25 knots becoming west. Sunny.
Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet. 
.TONIGHT...West winds 15 to 25 knots becoming northwest. Partly
cloudy in the evening, then becoming mostly cloudy. Waves 2 to
4 feet. 
.MONDAY...Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots becoming west 5 to
15 knots. Partly sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet subsiding to 1 foot or
less. 
.MONDAY NIGHT...Southwest winds 5 to 15 knots increasing to 15 to
20 knots. Mostly cloudy in the evening, then becoming partly
cloudy. Waves 2 feet or less. 

See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Tuesday through Thursday.

The water temperature off Toledo is 58 degrees, off Cleveland 61
degrees, and off Erie 59 degrees.
